title: Topo server backup
description: A backup a Topo server writes to a drive (docs/SCOPE.md D100, docs/FORMAT.md section 2). The network inside is end-to-end encrypted: rev.ct is the AES-GCM ciphertext of a Topo document (schema topo-v18.json), opened in a browser with an owner's own keys or an owner's recovery key. JSON keys are sorted; the server records the SHA-256 of the exact bytes.

site.description: The network's id on its server.

originHash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the server's origin, so a browser knows it is on the same server; the address itself is not written.

name.description: The network's name in clear, only when its owner allowed it; else null.

nameCt.description: The name encrypted, as the server holds it.

rev.description: The head revision exactly as the server stores it.

sig.description: The author's signature over the header.

ct.description: Base64 AES-GCM ciphertext of the document.

rosters.description: The member lists in force (signed), the head's and the newest.

pubs.description: Members' public keys (encPub, sigPub) that match the rosters.

owners.description: For each owner at backup time: their wrap of the site key for the head's epoch and their locked recovery copy (escrow), or null.

records.description: Records not yet folded into the document (step 7h, docs/SCOPE.md D159): a monitor's issues, people's acts on them and quiet windows, each sealed with the site key of its epoch and signed by its author. Absent when there are none.
